strategy.name: Prosus bounded baseline allocation
strategy.thesis: Prosus retains Tencent-dominated look-through value, ecommerce exposure and potential per-share accretion from repurchases below NAV, but the current allocation plan fails closed to zero exposure because the latest deterministic market retrieval is not usable; this watch-tier strategy is exit-only and does not authorize opening or retaining exposure.
strategy.entry_rule: Do not open or increase while allocation_plan_cf731760648bb43b2e47 and allocation_intent_b8f1131f2221ca6c0fec direct a zero-share close because market_data_not_ok; any future exposure requires a separate current allocation plan, accepted assessment and relationship, and fresh valid market inputs.
strategy.exit_rule: Close the existing long-equity exposure only through a time-bounded close signal bound to allocation_plan_cf731760648bb43b2e47 and allocation_intent_b8f1131f2221ca6c0fec; deterministic execution code derives the exact sell quantity from the zero-share target and current holdings and must revalidate executable market data before creating a paper order.
strategy.invalidation: No exposure may be added or retained under this plan. The prior bounded-entry case is invalid while canonical market data is not usable; independent thesis risks remain Tencent or private-platform deterioration, unreliable private marks, rising central net debt, blocked value transmission, lost repurchase accretion, or destructive capital allocation.
